profile.text: Wanqing, real name He Sheng, an Agricultural Tianshi apprentice of the Yanese Tianshi Bureaus. Produced significant research results in many Dahuang planting projects. Introduced to Rhodes Island by Shu, he is now on the landship as an exchange student and Logistics Operator.
